verdict.rationale: Databricks docs confirm a free trial signup path (databricks-docs-39) and a pay-as-you-go pricing model with no upfront costs (databricks-docs-21), suggesting some self-serve evaluation is possible. However, there is no evidence confirming that the trial requires no credit card or that it avoids a sales call, and community commentary focuses on cost complaints rather than trial mechanics. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that trial signup requires no credit card, evidence of real-data query access during trial without sales engagement, and independent corroboration of a frictionless self-serve trial experience.
